control_owner.budgets: current runner enforces K and replication counts plus backend per-call limits; aggregate hard limits below are a target contract, not implemented runtime control
control_owner.authorization: current runner is local-only; publication approval and reconciliation states below are a design target outside this implementation
control_owner.success_verdict: deterministic Lean oracle plus independent preregistered analyzer
control_owner.checkpoint: current runner creates a fresh x-mode JSONL and flushes each record; it has no resume or atomic-finalization protocol
control_owner.effects: current implementation writes local evidence only; publication intent, receipt, and reconciliation are not implemented

RunExperiment.risk: bounded model and deterministic oracle calls with local append-only output

PublishResult.risk: externally visible efficacy claim and immutable evidence publication

transitions.evidence: runner, analyzer, oracle, task, contract, and FSM hashes
complete JSONL attempt and summary records
P1-P5 tri-state verdict and matched-budget statistics
schema, provenance, parity, or conservation failure
local receipt and no publication request
artifact, destination, visibility, and verdict hashes
reconciled receipt with no pending interrupt

global_interrupts.deferred_behavior: record cancellation, reconcile publication, then honor cancellation
block new calls, reconcile publication, then terminate timed out
block new calls, reconcile publication, then terminate budget exhausted

budgets.soft_boundary: target behavior: finish the current attempt, flush JSONL, and emit an inconclusive handoff at 80 percent
budgets.hard_boundary_owner: required external harness budget governor; absent from the current runner
budgets.implementation: TARGET_ONLY: the current runner does not enforce aggregate wall, token, cost, retry, or suspended-time limits

no_progress.fingerprint: candidate hash plus diagnostic hash plus task, arm, and attempt
no_progress.gain_metric: new authoritative proof or positive graded-score delta under an unchanged oracle
no_progress.calibration: max_repeated_states is frozen before the live run
no_progress.scope: one pi_repair or pi_decoy arm loop
no_progress.plateau_comparator: the candidate and diagnostic fingerprints repeat without authoritative completion

retry.backoff: target behavior is bounded exponential backoff; the current runner performs no batch-level retry
retry.exhausted_outcome: RETRY_EXHAUSTED is a target state, not emitted by the current runner

effects.delivery_semantics: TARGET_ONLY: current local JSONL is append-and-flush; no outbox, publication, or receipt reconciliation exists
effects.idempotency_key: run_id, task, arm, attempt, artifact hashes, and destination hash
effects.durable_ledger: CURRENT: run_start, attempt, task_summary, and run_summary only; TARGET: analysis and publication receipts
effects.high_risk_gate: TARGET_ONLY: PublishResult would be reachable only through WAIT_HUMAN and PUBLISH_INTENT
effects.unknown_outcome: TARGET_ONLY: enter HUMAN_RECONCILIATION and never blindly retry publication
effects.implementation: The validator-required intent/outbox fields describe a future control plane and must not be read as current runner conformance

boundaries: target only: before and after publication
checkpoint.compatibility: resume is unsupported in the current runner; any partial JSONL is invalid and the run must restart in a new file
checkpoint.migration: schema changes require a new preregistration version and explicit converter
checkpoint.fencing: current runner uses one writer and x-mode file creation but does not perform atomic rename or completion fencing
checkpoint.monotonic_sequence: attempt and record sequence increase within one run_id
checkpoint.integrity: every candidate, diagnostic, contract, runner, analyzer, oracle, task artifact, Lean toolchain pin, Lean version, and Lean executable is hashed or identity-bound
checkpoint.corruption_outcome: quarantine the batch and mark every efficacy gate absent
checkpoint.implementation: Append-and-flush evidence exists; checkpoint state, pending interrupts, approvals, resume, and atomic finalization are target-only

approval.revocation: revocation before publication-intent commit invalidates approval
approval.stale_outcome: target behavior is return to READY_FOR_REVIEW; current runner has no publication or approval path
approval.implementation: TARGET_ONLY: publication is outside the executable v2 harness

verification.success_predicate: B1 passes externally and all P1-P5 gates pass over a hash-valid, sandboxed, frozen-design batch; local harness success does not itself authorize publication
invariant_checks: only the deterministic oracle can mark a proof complete
required six arms are present for every task and run
budgets and record sequences are monotonic
pi_repair and pi_decoy use the production diagnostic_repair function
physical JSONL order matches the frozen task, arm, attempt, lifecycle, task-summary, and run-summary execution order
PI lifecycle kinds, candidate fingerprints, and diagnostic fingerprints bind every recorded attempt
every attempt has visible nonzero token telemetry and output tokens do not exceed the frozen per-attempt ceiling
the exact Lean toolchain pin, version, executable SHA-256, and sandbox runner match the frozen manifest
the recorded clean commit predates every run timestamp and result JSONL modification time
terminal states have no outgoing transitions
verification.environment_evidence: raw JSONL in physical execution order, Lean verdicts, lifecycle fingerprints, artifact and compiler-identity hashes, token and call ledgers, commit and file timestamps, and matched-budget recomputation
verification.evaluator_independence: the analyzer consumes records and does not generate proofs or oracle verdicts
verification.human_gray_band: missing usage, fewer than six live/non-tied tasks, concentrated single-task signal, sandbox absence, or hash drift remains inconclusive
verification.calibration: thresholds and equivalence margin are frozen in the v2 preregistration before any live batch
fault_tests: Lean toolchain, version, or executable hash drift
PI lifecycle deletion or fingerprint corruption
Lean child stdout or stderr flood
backend response model omission or mismatch
forged recorded oracle verdict or diagnostic
recorded commit newer than a run timestamp or result JSONL

replay.resume: unsupported: the current runner never resumes a partial file; start a new run_id and x-mode JSONL
replay.trajectory_replay: re-run model calls with the same declared seeds; outputs may diverge
deterministic_replay_requirements: frozen artifact, model, Lean toolchain, Lean version, and Lean executable identities
captured seeds, clock, identifiers, and token usage
analyzer re-execution of every attempt and diagnostic-decoy setup with exact verdict and normalized diagnostic equality
replay.implemented_evidence_replay: the claim analyzer replays every full-payload Lean attempt and pi_decoy setup through the frozen sandbox before statistics; replay absence or any verdict, score, diagnostic, or hash mismatch invalidates the batch

security.untrusted_content: model output and diagnostics are data and cannot issue harness control events
security.tool_least_privilege: live v2 must use the hash-recorded least-privilege sandbox runner; file contents are readable only from the private source directory, the exact frozen Lean toolchain, and minimum system runtime paths, while arbitrary home, repository, temporary, and /etc reads plus network, child execution, and outside-sandbox writes are denied; compiler output is incrementally captured with a hard byte ceiling and sandbox paths are normalized before replay comparison
security.compiler_identity: run-start and manifest bind lean/lean-toolchain, the full Lean version line, and the resolved Lean executable SHA-256; mutable elan defaults are forbidden
security.provenance_snapshots: record source paths, git commit, SHA-256, model identity, endpoint class, and run time
security.secret_isolation: raw JSONL and model prompts exclude credentials; publication credentials are unavailable to the model

trace.redaction: claim-bearing JSONL intentionally contains proof and diagnostic replay payloads but excludes credentials; the transition field list is a target model and is not emitted by the current runner
trace.implementation: Current JSONL uses record_sequence and run/task/arm evidence, not the full transition/checkpoint trace schema

icvc.inform: frozen tasks, oracle, arm definitions, model identity, hashes, and preregistered gates
icvc.constrain: six exact arms, K and replication caps, verified-only adoption, explicit file-read allowlist, exact Lean compiler identity, sandbox-only live verification, per-attempt output ceilings, and matched-budget analysis
icvc.verify: sandboxed deterministic Lean oracle, physical record-order validation, lifecycle fingerprint binding, commit-before-evidence provenance, independent analyzer, B1 trace equivalence, P1-P5, reference FSM and adversarial fault tests
icvc.correct: bounded diagnostic repair with repeated-state detection; no post-hoc threshold or task-band edits
